alerts.title: Maersk expects full return to Suez Canal by March 2027, SCA says
alerts.body: Maersk and COSCO moves signal a gradual return to Suez routing, easing capacity and transit times by March 2027.

briefing:
• Hormuz escalation is the top risk: seven tankers were damaged by fire and mines, and Iran claims seven more vessels were struck, threatening energy flows and war-risk costs.
• Container freight rates are up about 130% since February on Middle East tensions and are rising again, with Asia-North Europe at $3,442 per FEU, squeezing shippers' costs.
• A phased Suez and Red Sea return is expected by Q1 2027 as Maersk and COSCO reroute, which should add capacity and ease rates, while Panama Canal transits are up 4.1% despite weather risks.
